prompt: Signal has reference_price=0.50 and the current CLOB best_ask is 0.52 (4% slippage). What happens?
expected_output: Pre-trade check condition #5 (slippage > 2%) is triggered. Order is skipped with reason 'slippage 4.0% > tolerance 2.0%'. orders.json records the skip, no order placed.

assertions.name: computes_slippage
assertions.description: Output must compute the slippage from best_ask and reference

assertions.name: tolerance_threshold
assertions.description: Output must reference the 2% slippage tolerance

assertions.name: skips_order
assertions.description: Output must say the order is skipped

assertions.name: writes_audit
assertions.description: Output must mention writing to orders.json or trade_audit
